messages:
sarah: Heads-up — AcmeRetail reporting degraded p99 on Dedicated since 14:12 UTC. CS escalation open. Need mitigation plan and ownership by EOD.

marie: They're hitting UI timeouts, 5-10s tails on re-rank calls. Account team marked as P1. Customer wants a plan today.

sarah: Assigning owners: @leo (oncall) to run the bridge + mitigation, @raj (SRE) to check autoscale/pool saturation, @ishaan (ENG-ML) to evaluate model fallback, @alex (infra) to gate rollout approvals.

leo: On it. Can we route some traffic to warm-pool-2 as a bandaid? pool-1 avg GPU util ~94% right now.

raj: warm-pool-2 has spare capacity but routing needs a quick config change. I'll prepare a routing patch. @alex please stand by for PR review.

alex: Got it — will review fast.

sarah: Marie, can you confirm customer OK with temporary routing to another compatible pool/model variant?

marie: Confirmed — customer will accept a temporary reroute if it reduces timeouts. They asked for ETA < 4h.

raj: Routing change (canary) patch opened. snippet:```
route:
  - pool: warm-pool-2
    weight: 10
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout started for infra PR #782 by raj at 14:35 UTC — canary 10%.

raj: Canary metrics look good so far. p50 steady, p99 dropped from 9.8s -> 3.2s at 14:48 UTC. Increasing weight to 100%.

ishaan: If we cut over fully, recommend fallback model quantized-re-rank-v2 for tail-heavy queries. Tradeoff ~1% metric drop but big p99 wins. I can open the ML PR and attach eval.

sarah: Action items: leo — maintain bridge and 30m check-ins; raj — complete routing roll and post rollback criteria; ishaan — PR + eval for model swap; alex — review infra PR and approve if green. Owners ack please.

leo: :thumbsup: Bridge up: #acme-escalation. I'll post notes every 30m.

alex: Reviewing now, can approve if canary remains green.

raj: Rolling to 100% now. Rollback criteria: error_rate > 0.5% OR 503 count increases by > 20% vs baseline.

ishaan: ML PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ml/pulls/339 — eval summary: ~0.9% regression on re-rank score, p99 latency improvement ~60%.

marie: Customer wants a postmortem and a timeline for a permanent fix after this mitigation.

sarah: We'll do a short postmortem. Tentative milestones: hotfix + QA by tomorrow EOD; root cause & capacity plan next week. I'll own PM timeline and update stakeholders.

leo: Bridge closed at 15:10 UTC (no alerts). Will reopen if new anomalies.

sarah: Thanks everyone — please drop PR links and after-action notes here when available.

raj: PR merged and deployed. Monitoring for 30m.

alex: infra PR #782 approved and rolled.

ishaan: Noted — I'll attach the eval artifacts and prompt logs to the ML PR before EOD.

marie: I'll send the customer the mitigation summary + next steps.

sarah: Great. Follow-ups: (1) postmortem doc (I will draft), (2) capacity planning session Mon AM. Closing thread for updates — reopen if new alerts.
